# LanaPays.Us — Economy of Abundance / Ekonomija Obilja

> Together we build the Economy of Abundance — and have a good time.
> Gradimo skupaj Ekonomijo Obilja – in se mamo fajn :)

LanaPays.Us is the hub of the LANA payment services. A merchant receives the
full invoice plus a reward on top (2% standard, 5% with Lana8Wonder, up to 20%
in the Abundance model), the customer gets LANA back, and investors on
direct.lana.fund finance real, local consumption. LanaPays deducts nothing
from a sale.

## Live system (reference data from LanaConnects.us)
- https://lanapays.us/api/connects/overview — current Split, days in the Split,
  provider count, three most recently registered providers, latest 100 trades
  with status, funds waiting for investment, LANA in circulation, current BEF
  framework version. JSON, no auth. Fields are null when their source is down.
  Upstreams: https://thelana.life/api, https://direct.lana.fund/api/public and
  https://balancedexchangeframe.work/api/versions.

## Services
- https://simple.lanapays.us — Simple: sell for LANA in two minutes, LANA-only, self-service registration.
- https://mobile.lanapays.us — Economy of Abundance mobile till: cash + LANA, remote payment links.
- https://pay.lanapays.us — LanaPay: hosted checkout, payment links, lanapay.js, REST API + webhooks, WooCommerce.

## More
- Events: KIND 36677 Nostr events (https://lana.events).
- Where to buy: featured KIND 30901/30903 business units (https://shop.lanapays.us).
- Framework: https://balancedexchangeframe.work (Balanced Exchange Framework, llms.txt available).

## Technical solutions
- https://pos.lanapays.us — LanaPay POS: server-to-server API for physical tills (llms.txt available).
- https://feed.lanapays.us — Lana Feed: bulk catalogue import (llms.txt available).
- https://lanafund.me — LanaFund.Me: scan a key, register a unit and accept LANA payments, payout in 3 days.

## Other endpoints
- https://lanapays.us/api/posts?lang=sl|en — editorial posts (news, instructions, FAQ).
- https://lanapays.us/api/relay-query?kind=36677 — relay proxy for Nostr kinds used by the page.
